meta.title: LEPAS L6 PHEV – plug-in hybrid SUV
meta.description: The LEPAS L6 PHEV at LEPAS Pitești: a 279 hp plug-in hybrid SUV with up to 92 km electric and 1,058 km combined range (WLTP).

lepasL6Phev.name: LEPAS L6 PHEV
lepasL6Phev.subtitle: Electric in the city, carefree on long trips. 279 hp, up to 92 km on the battery alone and 1,058 km combined range (WLTP).

interior.dashboard: A digital cockpit built around the driver
interior.rear: Room for everyone in the back

comfort.title: Elegant Comfort
comfort.text: The Drive Your Elegance philosophy continues inside: materials that feel good, controls within easy reach and a calm atmosphere that makes any journey feel shorter.
comfort.connectedText: A generous central screen and digital instruments: navigation, phone and music are one gesture away, without taking your eyes off the road.
comfort.spaceText: Five genuinely usable seats, with generous head and knee room and storage designed for everyday things.
comfort.lastingText: Supportive seats, careful sound insulation and a suspension tuned for comfort – from the daily commute to holiday trips.

power.title: Two sources of energy, one journey without breaks
power.text: The 1.5 turbo petrol engine works together with an electric system fed by an 18.4 kWh battery. In the city you drive electric; on long trips you don't need to plan your stops.
power.highlight1: Up to 92 km on electricity alone (WLTP) – the daily commute, without petrol
power.highlight2: Up to 1,058 km on one tank and one charge (WLTP)
power.highlight3: The battery charges from a socket while the car is parked
power.footnote: WLTP figures, EU type approval, Essence and Elegance versions. Consumption with a depleted battery: 5.9 l/100 km; electric energy consumption: 14.8 kWh/100 km. Real-world figures vary with conditions, driving style and battery charge.

cta.title: Start your LEPAS L6 PHEV experience
cta.text: Request an offer and a LEPAS Pitești consultant will call you with all the details: versions, price, financing and delivery.

meta.title: LEPAS L6 BEV – 100% electric SUV
meta.description: The LEPAS L6 BEV at LEPAS Pitești: a fully electric SUV with up to 449 km of range (WLTP) and 30–80% fast charging in about 22 minutes.

lepasL6Bev.name: LEPAS L6 BEV
lepasL6Bev.subtitle: The electric SUV of the LEPAS range: up to 449 km on one charge (WLTP) and from 30 to 80% in about 22 minutes.

interior.dashboard: A digital cockpit built around the driver
interior.rear: Room for everyone in the back

comfort.title: Elegant Comfort
comfort.text: The Drive Your Elegance philosophy continues inside: materials that feel good, controls within easy reach and a calm atmosphere that makes any journey feel shorter.
comfort.connectedText: A generous central screen and digital instruments: navigation, phone and music are one gesture away, without taking your eyes off the road.
comfort.spaceText: Five genuinely usable seats, with generous head and knee room and storage designed for everyday things.
comfort.lastingText: Supportive seats, careful sound insulation and a suspension tuned for comfort – from the daily commute to holiday trips.

power.title: Silence, instant torque and 449 km of freedom
power.text: A 160 kW (217 hp) electric motor on the front axle and a 65 kWh LFP battery. No gears and no tailpipe emissions – just smooth acceleration and quiet.
power.highlight1: DC fast charging at up to 120 kW: 30–80% in about 22 minutes
power.highlight3: 3.3 kW V2L function: power electrical devices straight from the car
power.footnote: Figures announced by the manufacturer for European markets. The homologated values, equipment and price for Romania will be communicated by the importer; until then there may be differences.

cta.title: Be the first to know when the L6 BEV arrives
cta.text: Leave us your details and we'll let you know as soon as we have the price and delivery date for Romania.
